name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 3
notes: Lightweight wired mouse, no RGB, top-tier sensor. (Renamed from pulsefire-haste-3.)

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 3 Pro
notes: Pro tier of the Haste 3 line. Wireless dual-mode, RGB scroll wheel LED, lower DPI ceiling than wired Haste 3.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Saga Pro
notes: Flagship symmetric mouse. Per-zone RGB, hot-swappable side buttons, 8K polling on wired tether.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Dart
notes: Legacy wireless mouse. Maintained in the registry for historical reference; product is EOL.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Surge
notes: 360° RGB ring mouse. Distinctive light halo, ambidextrous symmetric body.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Saga
notes: Base of the Saga line. Symmetric body, single-zone RGB scroll wheel, dual-mode (2.4GHz + wired).

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste
notes: Original honeycomb-shell ultralight wired mouse. Superseded by Haste 2 then Haste 3.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste Wireless
notes: Wireless variant of original Haste. 100h battery life, 2.4GHz only.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 Pro
notes: Pro tier of Haste 2 line. Dual-mode wireless, RGB scroll wheel. Superseded by Haste 3 Pro.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 S
notes: Symmetric variant of Haste 2 wireless. Available in two colorways.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 Wireless
notes: Wireless Haste 2 (non-Pro). 2.4GHz, no RGB.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 Core Wireless
notes: Entry-tier wireless Haste 2. Simplified button layout, lower DPI ceiling.

name: HyperX Pulsefire FPS
notes: Original FPS-focused wired mouse. Right-handed ergo shell, basic LED logo (no RGB).

name: HyperX Pulsefire FPS Pro
notes: RGB-enabled FPS Pro. Scroll-wheel + DPI indicator lighting. Higher DPI ceiling than original FPS.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Core
notes: Entry-level wired mouse. Single-zone logo lighting, value tier.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Raid
notes: MMO mouse with 11 programmable side buttons. Right-handed ergo.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Fuse
notes: Wireless mid-tier mouse. 2.4GHz only, no Bluetooth fallback.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins 65
notes: 65% wired mechanical, per-key RGB, hardware/software dual-mode. This is the modal's default render today, so a no-op spec is a useful baseline.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins 2 Pro 65
notes: Pro tier of Origins 2 in 65% format. Magnetic Hall-effect switches with adjustable actuation, USB-C wireless dongle support.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins 2 1800
notes: Origins 2 in 1800 / compact full-size layout. Numpad + media row, same Hall-effect switches as the Pro 65.

name: HyperX Eve 1800
notes: Concept full-size board with experimental cap profile. RGB + LCD volume wheel.

name: HyperX Alloy Rise 75 Wireless
notes: 75% wireless mechanical with rotary control knob. Sub-brand of Alloy — distinct from Origins.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins 2 65
notes: 65% compact mechanical, second generation. Sibling of Pro 65 — drops hot-swap sockets and Hall-effect sensing for a price cut.

name: HyperX Alloy Rise 75
notes: Wired version of Rise 75 Wireless. Same rotary knob + 75% layout, no battery.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins
notes: Original full-size Alloy Origins. Aluminum frame, per-key RGB. Foundation of the Origins line.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins Core
notes: Tenkeyless Alloy Origins. Same aluminum frame, no numpad.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins 60
notes: 60% compact Alloy Origins. Available in two colorways.

name: HyperX Alloy Rise
notes: Full-size Alloy Rise with rotary knob. Predecessor to Rise 75.

name: HyperX Alloy MKW100
notes: Entry-tier mechanical. Red-only LED backlight (no RGB), TTC red switches.

name: HyperX Alloy Elite
notes: Original Alloy Elite. Full-size with dedicated media keys + volume wheel. Red-only LED (no per-key RGB).

name: HyperX Alloy Elite 2
notes: Successor to Alloy Elite. RGB per-key, pudding keycaps, dedicated media keys + volume wheel.

name: HyperX Cloud III S
notes: Flagship wireless headset. Full feature set — exercises the all-defaults path. Six factory colorways.

name: HyperX Cloud III
notes: Wired sibling of Cloud III S. Eight factory colorways — the broadest palette in the lineup.

name: HyperX Cloud II Wireless
notes: Long-running wireless headset, dual chamber drivers, USB-A dongle.

name: HyperX Cloud Flight 2
notes: Wireless gaming headset with detachable boom mic. Three colorways including Lavender LE.

name: HyperX Cloud Stinger 3 Wireless
notes: Entry-level wireless headset. Two colorways. Replaces the wired Stinger 2 in the active lineup.

name: HyperX Cloud Stinger 3 Wired
notes: Wired Stinger 3. Same drivers as wireless, USB-A + 3.5mm switchable. No spatial audio.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha Air
notes: Lightweight refresh of the Cloud Alpha line. Wireless 2.4GHz, no detachable cable.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha
notes: Original wired Cloud Alpha. Dual-chamber driver design, detachable mic. No surround.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha 2
notes: Second-gen Cloud Alpha. Refined dual-chamber drivers, improved comfort.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha S
notes: Cloud Alpha with 7.1 surround box and bass-adjustment sliders on each cup.

name: HyperX Cloud II Core
notes: Entry tier of the Cloud II line. Wired-only, simplified controls, no detachable mic.

name: HyperX Cloud Mix 2
notes: Cloud Mix 2: full wireless. 2.4GHz + Bluetooth dual-mode, longer battery vs original Mix.

name: HyperX Cloud Mix Buds
notes: True-wireless earbuds. 2.4GHz dongle + Bluetooth, in-ear form factor.

name: HyperX Cloud Mix Buds 2
notes: Second-gen wireless earbuds. ANC, longer battery, upgraded drivers.

name: HyperX Cloud Stinger Core+ 7.1
notes: Entry-tier wired headset with 7.1 surround via USB dongle. Lightweight Stinger frame.

name: HyperX Cloud Stinger S
notes: Stinger with virtual 7.1 surround. Software-based, no USB dongle.

name: HyperX Cloud Stinger 2
notes: Direct predecessor to Stinger 3. Wired, no spatial audio, no equalizer.

name: OMEN OLED 27
notes: 27" QHD 240Hz OLED gaming monitor. HDR400, USB-C 65W, KVM. Sits between the legacy Pulse 25 and the upcoming flagship Pulse 32.

name: Treehouse 32
notes: 32" 4K 240Hz OLED flagship concept (monitor section). Thunderbolt 4 90W, built-in speakers, Gear Switch (KVM) — keyboard & mouse follow the active computer. Concept SKU from the monitor-integration branch.

name: OMEN Forge 45L
notes: 45L mid-tower desktop. Discrete GPU only, no graphics switcher. Includes Cryo Chamber liquid cooling and tool-less side panel.

name: OMEN Forge 45L — GPU
notes: GeForce RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 — flagship discrete GPU. Triple-slot, 360mm length, 600W TDP, dual 12V-2x6 connector.

name: OMEN Forge 45L — Cryo Chamber
notes: Cryo Chamber 360mm liquid AIO with copper cold plate, dual-tower pump, triple PWM fans.

name: OMEN Forge 45L — Memory
notes: 64GB (2×32GB) DDR5-7200 RGB kit. CL34, on-die ECC, XMP 3.0 / EXPO profiles.

name: OMEN Forge 45L — PSU
notes: 1200W 80+ Platinum fully modular ATX 3.1 PSU. Native 12V-2x6 connector for 600W GPU support.

name: OMEN Forge 45L — Hub Pro
notes: OMEN Hub Pro: 9 PWM fan channels + 12 addressable RGB zones. OMEN Light Studio sync ecosystem with per-app reactive palettes.

name: QuadCast 2 S
notes: Flagship USB-C condenser. Four pickup patterns, RGB ring, tap-to-mute top plate, internal shock mount, integrated pop filter.

name: SoloCast 2 Pro
notes: Compact cardioid-only USB-C mic for streamers. Tap-to-mute, plug-and-play, no RGB.

name: FlipCast
notes: Premium broadcast-quality condenser with signature flip-to-mute gesture (90° hinge mute). Dual pickup patterns, USB-C, RGB ring.

name: QuadCast 2
notes: Non-S QuadCast 2. Four pickup patterns, RGB ring, tap-to-mute, USB-C. Drops the S's hardware gain dial.

name: SoloCast 2
notes: Base SoloCast 2. Cardioid-only USB-C, tap-to-mute, no RGB. Drops the Pro's higher sample rate.

name: DuoCast
notes: Compact dual-pattern condenser. Cardioid + omnidirectional, RGB indicator ring, USB-C, tap-to-mute.

name: QuadCast
notes: Original QuadCast. Four pickup patterns, RGB body, USB-A, tap-to-mute. Predecessor to QuadCast 2.

name: QuadCast S
notes: QuadCast S: original QuadCast with full RGB lighting effects and NGENUITY control. USB-A.

name: SoloCast
notes: Original SoloCast. Cardioid-only USB-A, tap-to-mute, no RGB. Compact streamer mic.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste — Naruto Red Edition
notes: Limited-edition Pulsefire Haste with Naruto red colorway and exclusive packaging.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste — TTT Edition
notes: Limited-edition Pulsefire Haste with TTT branded colorway. Signature accents.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste — Aimlabs Edition
notes: Limited-edition Pulsefire Haste co-branded with Aimlabs. Ships with Aimlabs Pro trial.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste — Hex Worlds Edition
notes: Limited-edition Pulsefire Haste with Hex Worlds artwork.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha S — Naruto Orange Edition
notes: Limited-edition Cloud Alpha S with Naruto orange theming. Includes themed carrying pouch.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha S — Naruto Red Edition
notes: Limited-edition Cloud Alpha S with Naruto red theming. Includes themed carrying pouch.

name: HyperX Cloud Alpha S — TTT Edition
notes: Limited-edition Cloud Alpha S with TTT branded colorway.

name: HyperX Alloy Elite 2 — TTT Edition
notes: Limited-edition Alloy Elite 2 with TTT branded keycap set. Signature space bar.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins — Naruto Orange Edition
notes: Limited-edition Alloy Origins with Naruto orange theming + exclusive keycaps.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins — Naruto Red Edition
notes: Limited-edition Alloy Origins with Naruto red theming + exclusive keycaps.

name: OMEN Max 16
notes: Flagship 16" gaming notebook. Vapor chamber cooling, OLED display, per-key RGB keyboard, manual overclocking via OMEN Gaming Hub.

name: OMEN Max 16 — Keyboard
notes: Built-in keyboard: 100% layout, per-key RGB, anti-ghosting, 26-key rollover.

name: OMEN Max 16 — Display
notes: 16" OLED panel, QHD+ 240Hz, factory color-calibrated, HDR True Black 500.

name: OMEN Max 16 — Trackpad
notes: Precision glass trackpad with haptic feedback and full Windows Precision gesture support.

name: OMEN Max 16 — Webcam
notes: 1080p IR webcam with privacy shutter, Windows Hello, and NPU-accelerated AI effects.

name: OMEN Max 16 — Audio
notes: Quad-speaker array tuned by Bang & Olufsen, DTS:X Ultra. Four-mic top-firing array with AI noise cancellation + beamforming.

name: OMEN Max 16 — I/O
notes: Full desktop-replacement I/O: HDMI 2.1, dual Thunderbolt 4, dual USB-A, RJ-45 2.5GbE, SD card reader. Wi-Fi 7 + Bluetooth 5.4.

name: OMEN Transcend 14
notes: 14" ultraportable gaming notebook. Tobii Eye Tracking, OLED 2.8K display, slim chassis. No vapor chamber (thin-and-light cooling); no manual overclocking.

name: OMEN Transcend 14 — Keyboard
notes: Built-in keyboard: 4-zone RGB backlight, anti-ghosting, 1.5mm key travel.

name: OMEN Transcend 14 — Display
notes: 14" OLED panel, 2.8K 120Hz, 16:10 aspect, factory color-calibrated.

name: OMEN Transcend 14 — Trackpad
notes: Precision glass trackpad with full Windows Precision gesture support. No haptic motor on this tier.

name: OMEN Transcend 14 — Webcam
notes: 1080p IR webcam paired with Tobii Eye Tracking sensor bar. Privacy shutter, Windows Hello, NPU-accelerated AI effects.

name: OMEN Transcend 14 — Audio
notes: Dual top-firing speakers tuned for vocal clarity. Two-mic array with AI noise cancellation. No DTS:X on this tier.

name: OMEN Transcend 14 — I/O
notes: Thin-and-light I/O: HDMI 2.1, dual Thunderbolt 4, USB-A, microSD. No RJ-45 (Wi-Fi 7 only). Bluetooth 5.4.
